import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem cubic_mod_three_of_not_dvd (a : ℤ) (hnd : ¬ (3 : ℤ) ∣ a) : a ^ 3 ≡ a [ZMOD 3] := by
  have h₁ : a % 3 = 1 ∨ a % 3 = 2 := by
    
    have h₂ : ¬ (3 : ℤ) ∣ a := hnd
    have h₃ : a % 3 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply h₂
      exact Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero h
    
    have h₄ : a % 3 = 1 ∨ a % 3 = 2 := by
      have h₅ : a % 3 = 0 ∨ a % 3 = 1 ∨ a % 3 = 2 := by omega
      rcases h₅ with (h₅ | h₅ | h₅) <;> simp [h₅, Int.emod_eq_emod_iff_emod_sub_eq_zero] at h₃ ⊢ <;>
        (try omega) <;> (try tauto)
    exact h₄
  
  rcases h₁ with (h₁ | h₁)
  · 
    have h₂ : a ^ 3 % 3 = a % 3 := by
      have h₃ : a % 3 = 1 := h₁
      have h₄ : a ^ 3 % 3 = 1 := by
        calc
          a ^ 3 % 3 = (a % 3) ^ 3 % 3 := by
            simp [pow_three, Int.mul_emod, Int.add_emod]
          _ = 1 ^ 3 % 3 := by rw [h₃]
          _ = 1 := by norm_num
      omega
    exact h₂
  · 
    have h₂ : a ^ 3 % 3 = a % 3 := by
      have h₃ : a % 3 = 2 := h₁
      have h₄ : a ^ 3 % 3 = 2 := by
        calc
          a ^ 3 % 3 = (a % 3) ^ 3 % 3 := by
            simp [pow_three, Int.mul_emod, Int.add_emod]
          _ = 2 ^ 3 % 3 := by rw [h₃]
          _ = 8 % 3 := by norm_num
          _ = 2 := by norm_num
      omega
    exact h₂

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem cubic_mod_three_of_not_dvd (a : ℤ) (hnd : ¬ (3 : ℤ) ∣ a) : a ^ 3 ≡ a [ZMOD 3] := by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ a % 3 :=
    Int.emod_nonneg _ (by norm_num)
  
  have hlt : a % 3 < 3 := by
    have h := Int.emod_lt a (by norm_num : (3 : ℤ) ≠ 0)
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  
  have hdecomp : 3 * (a / 3) + a % 3 = a :=
    Int.ediv_add_emod a 3
  
  have hrange : a % 3 = 0 ∨ a % 3 = 1 ∨ a % 3 = 2 := by
    omega
  
  rcases hrange with hzero | hone | htwo
  · exfalso
    apply hnd
    rw [Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero]
    simpa [hzero]
  
  · have har : a ≡ (1 : ℤ) [ZMOD 3] := by
      rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
      use -(a / 3)
      omega
  
    have hpow := har.pow 3
    have honepow : (1 : ℤ) ^ 3 ≡ 1 [ZMOD 3] := by
      norm_num [Int.ModEq, Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
  
    exact hpow.trans honepow |>.trans har.symm
  
  · have har : a ≡ (2 : ℤ) [ZMOD 3] := by
      rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
      use -(a / 3)
      omega
  
    have hpow := har.pow 3
    have htwopow : (2 : ℤ) ^ 3 ≡ 2 [ZMOD 3] := by
      norm_num [Int.ModEq, Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
  
    exact hpow.trans htwopow |>.trans har.symm

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem cubic_mod_three_of_not_dvd (a : ℤ) (hnd : ¬ (3 : ℤ) ∣ a) : a ^ 3 ≡ a [ZMOD 3] := by
  have hmod : a % 3 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hnd
    exact (Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero).2 h
  
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ a % 3 :=
    Int.emod_nonneg a (by norm_num)
  
  have hlt : a % 3 < 3 := by
    have h := Int.emod_lt a (by norm_num : (3 : ℤ) ≠ 0)
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  
  have hcases : a % 3 = 1 ∨ a % 3 = 2 := by
    omega
  
  rcases hcases with h1 | h2
  · have hd : (3 : ℤ) ∣ a - 1 := by
      apply Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero
      omega
  
    have ha : (a ≡ (1 : ℤ) [ZMOD 3]) := by
      apply (Int.modEq_iff_dvd).2
      have hneg : (3 : ℤ) ∣ -(a - 1) := dvd_neg.mpr hd
      convert hneg using 1 <;> ring
  
    calc
      a ^ 3 ≡ (1 : ℤ) ^ 3 [ZMOD 3] := ha.pow 3
      _ ≡ a [ZMOD 3] := by simpa using ha.symm
  
  · have hd : (3 : ℤ) ∣ a + 1 := by
      apply Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero
      omega
  
    have ha : (a ≡ (-1 : ℤ) [ZMOD 3]) := by
      apply (Int.modEq_iff_dvd).2
      have hneg : (3 : ℤ) ∣ -(a + 1) := dvd_neg.mpr hd
      convert hneg using 1 <;> ring
  
    calc
      a ^ 3 ≡ (-1 : ℤ) ^ 3 [ZMOD 3] := ha.pow 3
      _ ≡ a [ZMOD 3] := by norm_num at *; exact ha.symm

set_option autoImplicit false

theorem cubic_mod_three_of_not_dvd (a : ℤ) (hnd : ¬ (3 : ℤ) ∣ a) : a ^ 3 ≡ a [ZMOD 3] := by
  rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
  apply (Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero).2
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ a % 3 :=
    Int.emod_nonneg _ (by norm_num)
  have hlt : a % 3 < 3 :=
    Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ (by norm_num)
  have hcases : a % 3 = 0 ∨ a % 3 = 1 ∨ a % 3 = 2 := by
    omega
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
  · simp [Int.sub_emod, Int.mul_emod, pow_succ, h0]
  · simp [Int.sub_emod, Int.mul_emod, pow_succ, h1]
  · simp [Int.sub_emod, Int.mul_emod, pow_succ, h2]
